request.description: the same clockwork AXE MACHINE shut into its shell: the round riveted metal shell closed tight like a pillbug, four jointed legs tucked under, the crescent axe blade folded flat along the shell, the big brass winding key on its back mid-turn, the small pale lens flickering faintly through a slit, a few loose cogs lying beside it, pixel art of an ancient mining automaton that was never switched off, still working in a buried city, body of tarnished pale metal plates and worn stone with visible rivets, brass cogs and a taut cable, hard straight edges and crisp metallic highlights, thin dark ink outline, one small pale glowing lens where a face would be, no mouth, no fur, no animal features, cold patient and a little sad, palette of cream paper, tarnished silver, weathered brass, dusty blue-grey slate and ink, low contrast
